scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir dist-mv2 --warnings-as-errors --self-hosted && npm run lint:mv3
scripts.check: npm run lint:js && npm run fmt:check && npm run build && npm run check:artifacts && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.deploy:production: cd worker && npx wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.deploy:staging: cd worker && npx wrangler deploy --env staging
